name: ux-project
description: UX discovery partner for designers — turn raw PM PRDs into KB-grounded ux-onepage and design-brief, with project-level context-memory (stakeholders/constraints/terminology/history/preferences), continuous context absorption (/ux-project:add-context + auto-propose), stale-onepage regen with diff, cross-project designer-preferences, state.md size cap, cite-or-die enforcement, and (v0.3) UI-first questioning — every designer-facing question is delivered via Claude Code's AskUserQuestion picker, not plain text.
